test.result: 103 passed; Ruff and mypy passed for the charter module.

implemented: Protected charter identity freezes strategy/model, rights, calendar, universe, execution costs, benchmark definitions, capital, parameters, horizon and cohort date ranges.
Risk/stop policy now has an explicit SHA-256 identity input; changing it changes the charter hash.
Durable append-only charter registration binds the cohort schedule to the exact charter hash; retroactive edits require a new version and later prospective start.
Closed cohort outcomes are immutable and registry recovery validates the append-only history.
blockers: The schedule stores date ranges rather than the explicit exchange-session date list resolved from the frozen calendar.
No authoritative future exchange calendar is loaded into a production cohort scheduler; no prospective cohort is claimed as started.
